risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively specific, including self-insurance accruals, prepaid insurance, debt maturities, borrowing capacity, and covenant compliance. Key risks include estimation uncertainty in claims, taxes, depreciation, and revenue recognition, as well as substantial self-insurance exposure and upcoming senior-note maturities. Overall tone is moderately positive, supported by higher earnings and stated liquidity, but includes standard forward-looking and adverse-outcome caveats.
